title: Divided power envelopes commute with Tor-controlled flat base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must extend divided powers through a possibly nonflat algebra base change. A polynomial presentation and the Tor hypothesis identify the relation ideal intersection, while flatness modulo the original divided power ideal proves an auxiliary injection that allows divided powers to descend through the quotient.
